name: Warren County, IL
findings: Warren County has 76 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Warren County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
63% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Warren County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 63% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
